questions.label: (i)
questions.title: Ferris wheel view
questions.prompt:
A Ferris wheel of radius $10$ m has its centre $12$ m above the ground and turns once every $4$ minutes. A rider starts at the lowest point, so their height after $t$ minutes is $h=12-10\cos\!\left(\dfrac{\pi t}{2}\right)$.

Find the height after $1$ minute.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels shown: 17 m, start. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.label: (ii)
questions.title: Ferris wheel view

For how long during each revolution is the rider more than $17$ m above the ground?

traps.why: Gave the end time, not the duration.
